prior_quote_correction.scope: Already published source fidelity correction for36/37, not a new finding.

root_material_corrections.reason: The source proposes process/material personification; it does not observe label-to-state bindings. Person identity, patient role, material and process stage can coincide. The proposed comparison needs specified models with different predictions.
root_material_corrections.reopening: Freeze one semantic target and its person/material/state rivals. Obtain source-bound labels with actual variation across the competing axes, then test the predeclared predictions; do not infer lexical identity from a correlated physical scene.

root_material_corrections.reason: A class can have one observed member, and a slot can have a fixed ordinal. Thus a sample-level one-to-one form/member or form/ordinal association does not by itself falsify a class/slot interpretation. GDT793 model survival is not class-meaning confirmation.
root_material_corrections.reopening: Specify the class or slot ontology and an exclusion that separates it from a unique-member or ordinal code. Establish actual held cross-member/class variation; a frozen injective name contract is narrower than all naming.

root_material_corrections.reason: A component can itself be an object, and its name can denote a class shared by many owners. The design disjoins component and process-state readings but contrasts them with an overly strict object-owner model. A generic object name need not have one physical owner.
root_material_corrections.reopening: Choose the precise component-class, individual-object or state contract and its rival. Predeclare different predictions under independently crossed stage, component and owner contexts; do not equate all object names with unique individual identifiers.

root_material_corrections.reason: Treatment mode, material state and patient identity can co-occur; GDT210 provides a covariance prediction, not observed Voynich treatment labels. Current wording does not specify one mode or distinguish a procedural instruction from a correlated state/material label.
root_material_corrections.reopening: Fix the procedural mode or position and rival lexical commitments before selection. Use independently bound contexts where those commitments differ; physical mode covariance alone is not semantic selection.

root_material_corrections.reason: The mechanism includes return, junction and side outlet, while its falsifier focuses on return/junction enrichment. A genuine side-outlet code could fail that test without contradicting the broader mechanism. Topology and component identities can also coincide.
root_material_corrections.reopening: Freeze the exact topology category or permitted category set, and align the falsifier with that scope. Require held variation that separates its specified prediction from component, endpoint and owner alternatives; do not select a category after seeing results.

relation_decisions.reason: Both use cross-owner state recurrence, but figure/personification and generic diagram component/state contracts differ.
Figure process/material personification and procedural treatment mode are distinct proposed targets with overlapping scenes.
Class/slot versus member identity overlaps diagram component classes, but the declared rival and target scope differ.
Component/state identity and graph topology can describe the same locus; neither complete design is an exact duplicate of the other.

limits: Four undirected related pairs are stored once each; incoming relation lookup preserves discoverability. No duplicate_of or equivalence merge is proposed.

Accurate annotations with perfectly coupled covariates cannot distinguish models that make the same predictions. Crossed coverage can test specified restricted models but does not automatically identify a lexeme.
Independent semantic evidence may come from a discriminating source or linguistic relation; lack of the present annotations is not a universal ban on semantic inference or structural research.
Peer drafts are non-operative conceptual drafts: root converts their prose scope, string blockers and relation keys to the existing executable review schema. No new infrastructure is introduced.

To avoid presenting old malformed embedded quotations as new primary citations, design previews omit source_evidence. Complete original designs remain hash-bound in unchanged proposal files; HU supplies the already published exact corrections for36/37.
